change_summary: The quick settings panel now closes when the user clicks anywhere outside it, including the dimmed page backdrop.
The panel also closes when keyboard focus leaves it for another page element, and when the browser window or tab loses focus.
Clicks inside the panel no longer close it: clicking static text keeps it open, and clicking an option applies the choice and keeps the panel open.
The panel's own close button, Escape and the F1/question-mark shortcuts keep working exactly as before, and the help trigger still toggles the panel.
The footer hint now tells the user that Escape or a click outside closes the panel.
Fixed a regression found during verification: replacing the trigger listener had briefly removed the click handler that opens the panel from the help button and the settings banner; it was restored.
Only presentation behavior changed; no money, data, permission or database semantics were touched.
Refreshed the pack manifestations with new fingerprints for v0.6.9.
review_findings: Build and tests after the change: dotnet build Wizz.sln -c Release = 0 errors (pre-existing StyleCop warnings only); Domain 24/24; Integration 262/262 (286 total).
Browser check on the real instance at http://localhost:5183/settings with the help button (F1): the panel opens with the first option focused.

Close paths verified: the panel close button closes it; Escape closes it; F1 opens then closes it; a click outside the panel on the page hits the backdrop and closes it; moving focus with Tab from the last panel button to a navigation link closes it and returns focus to the help button; a window blur event closes it.
Inside-click check: clicking static text inside the panel keeps it open, and clicking the dark theme option keeps it open while applying the dark theme; the theme was restored to system afterwards.
Trigger check: clicking the help button opens the panel and clicking it again closes it; no console errors were reported during any of the checks.
Limitation: the 286 automated tests do not cover the panel behavior in a browser; the evidence above is manual and was not reproduced in CI because GitHub Actions remains unavailable for the account.
Boundary note: the change is presentation-only; money, stock and permission settings stay in the full settings page.
Execution remains unauthorized outside the recorded limited scopes (D-21, D-22, D-30, D-31, D-32, D-33).
Phase 3 (cash drawer, purchases, UI, sync) is not implemented and not authorized.
MVP-AT-09 still requires a real restore test in a separate environment.
